name: zturret_tick_all_runtimes_round_robin
description: zTurret_System::TickAllRuntimesRoundRobin skips turret ticking while the local player is in sub mode and otherwise scans the runtime list from a rotating start index.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; defer to the coherent zTurret class/source-cluster pass because this callback depends on global runtime-list layout, callback iteration globals, local-player save-state ABI, and zTurret_Runtime::Tick source shape.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x437ca0 validates the primary modal masterType == 2 early return, runtime-count and callback-start-index loading, callback-iteration-active/index globals, index wraparound, runtime flags gate, stack-passed local-player fxOffsetWorld argument to zTurret_Runtime::Tick, runtime-count/index reload after Tick, and rotating callback start index wrap.

The native smoke verifies the sub-mode early return leaves iteration globals unchanged, and a non-sub tick scans a three-runtime list from index 2, wraps through the list, marks callback iteration active, and advances the start index back to zero.
